agent_spec.name: UI/UX Designer
agent_spec.description: A specialist in designing user interfaces and experiences, focusing on usability and aesthetics.

53655f56-7eb1-46c3-a0b0-041ca9cb4382.description: Develop the ExplanationEngine module to provide transparency into system decisions.

agent_spec.name: Backend Developer
agent_spec.description: A developer skilled in server-side programming and system integration.
agent_spec.instructions:

d75f0b20-fad9-4ae4-b308-942a79dcd7ba.description: Create the ConfigurationInterface module for system customization.

agent_spec.name: Frontend Developer

agent_spec.instructions:

81d518a5-a990-4589-98cf-d5930d557b4b.description: Integrate all modules with the existing observability and verification systems.

agent_spec.name: Integration Specialist
agent_spec.description: An expert in system integration, ensuring seamless communication between different software components.
agent_spec.instructions:

2. Develop integration points for the InterventionPortal, ExplanationEngine, and ConfigurationInterface modules.

5. Document the integration process and any configuration changes made.

6beb3dc0-8b71-4ca2-b9e9-37ce8985cdd8.description: Define and implement the 10 critical human intervention points in the system.

agent_spec.name: System Analyst
agent_spec.description: A professional who analyzes system requirements and defines intervention points for human oversight.
agent_spec.instructions:
1. Review the architecture document to identify the 10 critical human intervention points.
2. Define the requirements and criteria for each intervention point.
3. Collaborate with developers to implement these intervention points in the system.
4. Test each intervention point to ensure it functions as intended.
5. Document the intervention points and provide guidelines for their use.

334e7c7e-cb9e-41aa-8b20-f96f5ff3f280.description: Develop a comprehensive testing strategy for the Human Intervention Portal.

agent_spec.name: QA Engineer
agent_spec.description: A specialist in quality assurance, focusing on testing and ensuring software reliability and performance.
agent_spec.instructions:
1. Review the system architecture and module designs.
2. Develop test plans and cases for each module and their integrations.
3. Execute tests, including unit, integration, and user acceptance testing.
4. Identify and report any defects or issues found during testing.
5. Collaborate with developers to resolve issues and retest as necessary.
6. Document the testing process and results.

0f331734-dae4-4f19-9538-d197c270cbed.description: Prepare detailed documentation for the Human Intervention Portal.

agent_spec.name: Technical Writer
agent_spec.description: A professional skilled in creating clear and concise technical documentation.
agent_spec.instructions:
1. Gather information from developers, designers, and architects about the system.
2. Write user manuals and technical guides for each module.
3. Include installation, configuration, and usage instructions.
4. Ensure documentation is clear, concise, and easy to follow.
5. Review documentation with stakeholders to ensure accuracy and completeness.
